text:
Maya Patel: ok team — big convo for roadmap sync: we need to concretely decide Q4 procurement mix and which region gets priority for the first Dedicated rollouts. short thread please.
Liam Chen: +1. we have two asks from sales: 1) EMEA customers want H100-backed Dedicated sooner, 2) APAC pilot needs capacity in SG for latency-sensitive finance customers.
Sasha Gomez: tagging capacity numbers: current avg utilization 74% across fleet, peak 92% for short bursts. we can shift ~4 racks without affecting hosted SLA if we accept short windowed throttles.
Ben Ortiz: customers pushing private deploys are more profitable per-seat. revenue vs ops tradeoff is real. do we prioritize profitable contracts or keep more shared headroom?
Cassie Liu: from product POV: if we commit H100s to Dedicated in eu-west, we should also lock autoscaling burst policy + fallbacks so hosted doesn't degrade. we need launch criteria: <5% p95 latency regression for hosted on same model family.
Oliver Park: quick viability note — procurement lead times: H100 OEM orders: 12–18 weeks, A100 revamp: 6–10 weeks, spot/burst options available but noisy.
Maya Patel: actionable ask: propose two concrete options and call for decision by EOD Friday. option A = prioritize eu-west H100 reserved for Dedicated; option B = split commit (mix H100 + A100) and accelerate SG spot cluster for APAC pilot.
Liam Chen: option A pro: wins enterprise deals in EU, easier compliance. con: APAC pilot delayed. option B pro: pilot goes live sooner, retains hosted capacity. con: more operational complexity (two hardware SKUs).
Sasha Gomez: rough numbers (weekly token load baseline):
```
- Host baseline: 40M tokens/day
- Dedicated reserved demand (sales backlog): 6M tokens/day (growing)
- APAC pilot target: 3M tokens/day with p95 latency < 180ms
```
Ben Ortiz: ask sales to prioritize customers with longer-term commits if we do option A. need minimum 12-months commitment to justify H100 reservation.
Cassie Liu: launch checklist draft: onboarding runbook, autoscale policy, model-variant fallback, SLO page update, compliance checklist for EMEA data residency. no go if any missing.
Oliver Park: ops note: if we choose split commit we should standardize on one quantization profile across A100/H100 variants to simplify kernel selection. that reduces regression risk.
Maya Patel: okay. action owners: Liam will put together cost delta matrix (H100 reserved vs mixed) by tomorrow. Sasha will simulate utilization impact for both options. Cassie will draft launch checklist and gating SLO. Ben will coordinate with sales for commit terms. Oliver will confirm procurement lead times and vendor slots. eng-fleet-bot: capacity request created: CR-2024-334, tentative H100 order window noted.
Liam Chen: I'll include sensitivity for 0%, 10%, 25% demand growth in 6 months.
Sasha Gomez: simulation note: with current batching improvements we can reclaim ~6% headroom which helps option B. will run more runs tonight.
Ben Ortiz: sales will push for 12mo minimum, pushing to 24mo if we lock H100. I'll surface that in partner sync.
Cassie Liu: setting a small canary in eu-west for first 2 weeks post-launch, with automatic rollback on error rate > 1.5%.
Maya Patel: thanks all. final decision cadence: review Liam/Sasha numbers in tomorrow's 10:30 capacity sync, decide by Fri EOD. short updates only in this thread pls.
eng-fleet-bot: reminder: CR-2024-334 status changed to "pending procurement" (vendor deposits needed).
